messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable first-person mining game about drilling from Earth’s surface to its core, with a nearby science lab for upgrades and an oil shop beside it.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Build the game now and briefly note assumptions when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks, viewport no wider than 1280px, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained browser game in a single `index.html`, using canvas-rendered pseudo-3D scenery and DOM-based HUD and menus.
- Assumed a surface outpost with a drill rig, science lab, and oil shack; oil canisters power the rig, samples earn credits, and lab upgrades increase drilling speed.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a playable game prototype with first-person movement/look, mobile controls, surface scenery, HUD, drilling progression, fuel shopping, lab upgrades, and a core-completion event.
- Started a local HTTP server on port `3002`; browser opened at `http://localhost:3002/`.
- Extracted the inline script and verified syntax with `node --check /tmp/opencode/game.js`.
- Confirmed the intro screen and HUD render in Playwright.

### Active
- Validate the gameplay flow and visual appearance; fix any issues found.
- Finish a successful screenshot check.

### Blocked
- `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/deep-shift.jpg` timed out after 5 seconds while waiting for fonts; no screenshot was captured.

## Next Move
1. Retry the Playwright screenshot, ideally after dismissing the intro with “BEGIN EXPEDITION”; inspect only the latest JPEG.
2. Test walking to the oil shack, buying fuel, loading it at the rig, drilling, and interacting with the lab; fix any gameplay or rendering defects.
3. Check `git status` and report implementation, checks, and reasonable assumptions in the final response.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` succeeded; its only console error was a missing `/favicon.ico` (404).
- Current browser page is still on the intro screen; `#introback` has class `show`.
- Screenshot attempt created/targeted `screenshots/deep-shift.jpg`, but failed.
